The logo: B1, the small line

Holger, 25 Sep: GLCA Medium stays. Can World of talk to Card Games in a more interesting, cohesive way, without a second face? Seventeen answers, all B1 with the words at 85% of the fan, after the logo as it is today, and then three with the fan in the middle of the words. Every row has a number and a name to refer to it by (say “4 Red” or “12 Arc”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.
